extra_quotes: We demonstrated the network on-chip with a hazardous gas detection experiment running on the mixed-signal neuromorphic chip TEXEL.

The network ran on a single core of the chip, which provides 90 neurons with 58 synapses each, 54 of them plastic and binary-valued – each synaptic weight can occupy only one of two states and changes state via on-chip Spike Timing Dependent Plasticity (STDP).
